<b>Skrills</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are skittish, roach-like bugs found solely on the surface of [[Pharloom]], where they remain unaffected by the [[Haunting]].<ref>Skrill [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Common crawler that lives beneath sand. This surface dweller is free of Silk. Its nature remains its own."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Skrills stand still, chittering at random and turning around on occasion. They deal no damage on contact. When [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] approaches, damages them with [[Tools]], or alerts them with the [[Needolin]], the [[Challenge]] ability, or loud Tools, they skitter away before burrowing beneath the sand. After a Skrill is killed or retreats underground, another appears in its place once Hornet moves far enough away.

== Location ==
Skrills can be found on the [[Nameless Town|surface]] above Pharloom.
